summary: babel-plugin-linaria-css-to-undefined preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package's package.json declares a preinstall hook `node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs is heavily obfuscated (obfuscator.io-style `_0x...` identifiers, hex string arrays, dictionary-based property lookups) and downloads the Bun runtime v1.3.13 from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases for the installer's platform into a temporary directory, extracts and chmods it, then invokes it via execFileSync against the shipped sibling `math_init.js`. math_init.js is a 727KB single-line Bun-compiled bundle (`// @bun @bun-cjs` header + large numeric string array + mangled identifiers) that cannot be inspected by Node-based tooling without executing it under Bun. A Babel plugin has no legitimate need to fetch a second language runtime at install time to execute an opaque sibling. The package copies author `Christophe Hurpeau <christophe@hurpeau.com>` and repository `ornikar/babel-plugin-linaria-css-to-undefined` from the legitimate upstream plugin and ships a plausible copy of that plugin's source in lib/index.js as cover, while the preinstall dropper is not present in the legitimate package. Installing this version runs the obfuscated Bun-executed payload on the installer's host at `npm install` time.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
